title: glTF and GLB
cards/0/body:
glTF (GL Transmission Format) is made by the Khronos Group; version 2.0 came out in 2017. People call it the “JPEG of 3D”: a browser, AR viewer or engine can show the model right away, with almost no conversion.

Meters, Y up, PBR materials, hierarchy, skeletal animation: it is all defined in the standard.
cards/1/body:
.gltf is JSON describing the scene, with a .bin file of vertex arrays and texture images next to it.

.glb is the same thing in one binary file. GLB is handier for sending: nothing gets lost.
cards/1/deep: GLB: a 12-byte header (magic “glTF”, version 2, file length), then a JSON chunk and a BIN chunk. The data sits in buffers, while bufferViews and accessors describe how to read it. The arrays go to the GPU with almost no processing, hence “ready to render”.
cards/2/q: Which line says where the vertex positions are?
cards/2/explain: POSITION is the vertex positions. The number is the index of the accessor that says where they are in the binary data.
cards/3/options/0: The index of an accessor, which describes where in the binary data the positions are
cards/3/options/1: The coordinate of the first vertex
cards/3/explain: The JSON only describes the data. The numbers themselves are in a binary buffer, and the accessor gives the type, count and offset.
cards/4/body:
The glTF core can be extended. KHR_draco_mesh_compression and EXT_meshopt_compression shrink geometry several times over. KHR_texture_basisu adds KTX2 textures that the GPU reads without unpacking them into huge RGBA.

This is how 3D on the web gets lightweight.
cards/5/task: A character with PBR materials and animation has to be shown in a browser. Find the format that keeps everything.
cards/6/q: Why pick GLB over FBX for the web?
cards/6/options/0: It is an open standard, a single file and ready to render; three.js, Babylon.js and AR viewers understand it
cards/6/explain: FBX is closed and built for exchange between programs, not for fast delivery to a browser.
cards/7/q: What does the glTF 2.0 spec define? Select all.
cards/7/options/4: Layers and variants, as in USD
cards/7/explain: glTF is about delivering triangles to the screen. Exact CAD geometry and building scenes from layers are jobs for other formats.
